segments.name: United States
segments.description: Provides freight forwarding, freight brokerage and value-added logistics services to shippers in the United States, also covering operations in Mexico.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized in two reportable segments: United States and Canada.

segments.name: Canada
segments.description: Provides freight forwarding, freight brokerage and value-added logistics services to customers shipping within and to and from Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company is organized in two reportable segments: United States and Canada.

revenueModel.text: Shippers pay us for arranging transportation and value-added logistics; we earn gross margin between what we charge customers and what we pay carriers.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate our gross margin on the difference between what we charge our customers for the services provided to them, and what we pay to the transportation providers to transport the customers freight.
